nationalSpirits.description: The Afar warriors have always been known for their fierce skill in desert combat, and it is because of this and the harsh terrain of the Danakil desert that Aussa has managed to avoid annexation by the Ethiopian empire for so long.
nationalSpirits.name: Warriors Skilled in Desert Warfare

nationalSpirits.description: King Zahir Shah ascended to the throne following the death of his father in 1933. However, due to his young age and lack of a political base of his own, the King’s uncles hold the real power in government, leaving him as little more than a figurehead. Zahir Shah will have to decide whether to bide his time and or quickly oust his uncles from office if he is to pursue any agenda of his own.
nationalSpirits.name: King Zahir Shah

nationalSpirits.description: The Pashtun people make up the largest and most politically powerful proportion of the population. A significant proportion of Pashtuns live by the traditional code of ethics and rules known as the Pashtunwali. This has made it difficult for governments to maintain power, let alone make reforms, when they appear to be at odds with the traditional code.
nationalSpirits.name: Pashtunwali

nationalSpirits.description: Since 1933, Turkish military personnel have aided in educating the next generation of Afghan soldiers. Perhaps in time, this arrangement could be expanded upon to bring our great nations closer together.
nationalSpirits.name: Turkish Military Mission

nationalSpirits.description: The majority of the population live rural lives, producing only enough food for themselves and their families to see out the harsh winter months. They have little interest in changing their way of life to accommodate sprawling profit generating industries and are unlikely to change that mindset regardless of who supposedly holds power in Kabul.
nationalSpirits.name: Subsistence Economy

nationalSpirits.description: While there are no formal treaties preventing the expansion of the Brazilian, Chilean or Argentinean navies, there has been an informal arrangement since the Great War that has prevented it. If any of the nations in the region were to begin arming their fleets with new capital ships, a new arms race would be inevitable.
nationalSpirits.name: Legacy of the Naval Arms Race

nationalSpirits.description: The Infamous Decade was a period in Argentine history that began with the 1930 coup d'état against President Hipólito Yrigoyen. It was a time marked by two things. On one hand, significant rural exodus following the Great Depression and on the other hand, blatant electoral fraud to perpetuate conservative governments in power.
nationalSpirits.name: Infamous Decade

nationalSpirits.description: The Roca-Runciman Agreement is a significant trade pact between Argentina and Britain signed in May 1933 that guaranteed Argentina with a fixed share in the British meat market. In exchange, Argentina agreed to restrictions with regard to trade and currency exchange, preserving Britain's commercial interests in the country.
nationalSpirits.name: The Roca-Runciman Treaty

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: For many years, Argentina has been plagued by fervent corruption within its government. Whilst it was thought that by allowing the Concordancia to form, this might have lessened, fraudulent votes and voter intimidation have continued to be present.
nationalSpirits.name: Political Corruption

nationalSpirits.description: When the Great Depression struck in 1929, Australian birth rates fell drastically. Combined with a decline in immigration, population growth has struggled to recover ever since.
nationalSpirits.name: Poor Population Growth

nationalSpirits.description: The Statute of Westminster was passed in 1931, allowing the self-governing Dominions of Britain to increase their sovereignty. If we were to ratify it, most of the British Parliament's authority to legislate for Australia would be removed.
nationalSpirits.name: Unratified Westminster Act

nationalSpirits.description: Following the economic crash Austria has struggled with inflation and high rates of unemployment. Resentment towards politicians is at a high level.
nationalSpirits.name: Widespread Unemployment

nationalSpirits.description: The Phönix insurance programme has allowed our enlisted to buy life insurance that covers them in the event that the worst should come to happen. Knowing that their families will be cared for has significantly increased the amount of people willing to join the army.
nationalSpirits.name: Phönix Insurance

nationalSpirits.description: The recovery from the economic crashes of the early 30's has been slow, but it seems that Austria is finally heading for better times.
nationalSpirits.name: Recovering From Economic Depression

nationalSpirits.description: Bound by a strict treaty signed after the Great War, the Austrian Army as well as the military industry are but a shadow of what they once were.
nationalSpirits.name: Treaty of Saint-Germain-en-Laye

nationalSpirits.description: Rejecting the western democratic parliamentarianism and operating as a corporate state, the Vaterländische Front find themselves the sole ruling party. The constitution has been recast to direct Austria towards Corporatism, Authoritarianism, and Nationalism.
nationalSpirits.name: Austrofascism

nationalSpirits.description: Belgium has been divided between two language groups: French, spoken by those from the Walloon regions, and Dutch, practiced by the Flemish. Each side is exceptionally proud of their culture and heritage, and language is tied closely to this so neither wishes to give theirs up, nor see their tongue become subservient to the other.
nationalSpirits.name: Language Barriers

nationalSpirits.description: The Chasseurs Ardennais are seasoned defenders of the Belgian Ardennes, highly experienced and trained in forest warfare.
nationalSpirits.name: Chasseurs Ardennais

nationalSpirits.description: Belgium suffered greatly in the Great War, being much of the battlefield for the Western Front, and it still bears those scars.
nationalSpirits.name: Scars of the Great War

nationalSpirits.description: Corruption runs rampant in our government, with a string of scandals involving a range of crimes including bribery and embezzlement. Popular trust in our democratic institutions has never been lower.
nationalSpirits.name: Corruption

nationalSpirits.description: Our economy has been in tatters since the last war turned our nation into a battlefield, the recovery only further impeded by the effects of the global depression that we are still struggling to recover from.
nationalSpirits.name: Economic Downturn

leader.name: Ida I Dewa Agung Gde Oka Geg

nationalSpirits.description: The recent decades have been tough on Bolivia. First the War of the Pacific from 1879 to 1883, then the Acre War from 1899 to 1903, and finally the nation's most recent defeat, the Chaco War from 1932 to 1935.
nationalSpirits.name: The Era of National Regression

nationalSpirits.description: The Chaco War has just ended, having lasted from 1932 to 1935. The will to fight has been completely drained from even the most ardent supporters of expansionism in both Bolivia and Paraguay, and many lay dead in the still disputed region of Chaco Boreal.
nationalSpirits.name: The Toll of the Chaco War

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: While there are no formal treaties preventing the expansion of the Brazilian, Chilean or Argentinean navies, there has been an informal arrangement since the Great War that has prevented it. If any of the nations in the region were to begin arming their fleets with new capital ships, a new arms race would be inevitable.
nationalSpirits.name: Legacy of the Naval Arms Race

nationalSpirits.description: There are many across the nation who have grievances with the central government of Brazil or who resent having to support the less affluent states of the nation. In the past these sentiments have lead to short lived separatist movements breaking their states away from the nation. If we fail to stabilize the political situation soon, such movements may cause the fragmentation of Brazil.
nationalSpirits.name: Separatist Sentiments

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: Over reliance on coffee exports left the Brazilian economy crippled when the great depression hit and the nations of the world stopped purchasing the addictive stimulant. Any government will have to diversify the economy into new areas if the nation is to thrive.
nationalSpirits.name: Undiversified Economy

nationalSpirits.description: Revolutions and attempted coups over the years have weakened the authority of the Brazilian government. The situation is made worse by the 1934 constitution, an agreement forged from compromise and garners few supporters. Whatever the future of Brazil may be, it is certain that the current political arrangement is untenable.
nationalSpirits.name: Weak Government

nationalSpirits.description: A state of emergency was declared in November 1935 when the communists launched a coup that threatened to spiral into full scale civil war. Although the coup was thwarted, the President is yet to end the state of emergency. Many across the political spectrum now worry that the regime will continue to use the emergency powers to quell any further dissent.
nationalSpirits.name: State of Emergency

nationalSpirits.description: Another consequence of the Treaty of Neuilly-sur-Seine are the severe restrictions imposed on our army, not only do they prohibit compulsory military service, limit the amount of troops and officers in our forces and prevent us from maintaining any advanced equipment, they also prohibit any military maneuvers or campaign planning and even stipulate the number of rifles we can use.
nationalSpirits.name: Army Restrictions

nationalSpirits.description: Following our defeat in the Great War, the Treaty of Neuilly-sur-Seine forced us to cede vast territories that now belong to Yugoslavia, Greece, and Romania, and until recently the League of Nations required us to prioritize the payment of large sums of war reparations, crippling our economy and inevitably increasing the debt of our country. The national spirit has never really recovered from this blow, so it is no wonder why this treaty is popularly known in Bulgaria as the Second National Catastrophe...
nationalSpirits.name: Second National Catastrophe

nationalSpirits.description: The constant fratricidal crimes committed by the Internal Macedonian Revolutionary Organization have seriously damaged our international relations and led in 1934 to the military crackdown of the IMRO stronghold in Petrich, dealing a critical blow to the organization and forcing most of their leaders to flee abroad. However, some revolutionary cells are still active in Bulgaria, and most of our diplomatic relations remain in a poor state.
nationalSpirits.name: IMRO

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: The Kuomintang's Whampoa Military Academy holds the power over new recruits and promotions within the army. Though not entirely inefficient, it does contain a large amount of institutionalized corruption.

effects.label: Starting level of new army leaders

nationalSpirits.name: Whampoa Primacy

nationalSpirits.description: Greased wheels turn easier, but that does not equate to efficiency. A couple individuals exert unproportional power which is having effects on a national state.
nationalSpirits.name: Corruption in the Administration

nationalSpirits.description: Our industrialisation is nascent as previous governments have not supported proper growth. We can however solve this through internal and external measures, our potential is truly limitless.
nationalSpirits.name: Inefficient Economy

nationalSpirits.description: The National Revolutionary Army came from the ranks of the party and thus carry the same baggage the party does. Nepotism, bribery, and embezzlement are rife and if we are to prevail something that we will have to stamp out.
nationalSpirits.name: Corruption in the Armed Forces

nationalSpirits.description: Underground markets and smuggling networks undermine government authority and disrupt economic stability. Efforts to curb these activities remain haphazard and the influence of illicit trade continues to hinder national unity and reform.
nationalSpirits.name: Illicit Trade

nationalSpirits.description: Since its inception in the last decade the Aviation Affairs Commission has been the organisation through which we will take control of our sky. While still not a centralised air force the march of progress continues and through perseverance we shall prevail.
nationalSpirits.name: Aviation Affairs Commission

nationalSpirits.description: The Nanjing decade has seen truly impressive changes to our society. However modernity has been mostly limited to urban areas and the countryside have been overlooked. This could lead to the breeding ground of radical ideas.
nationalSpirits.name: Neglected Countryside

effects.label: Justify war goal time on us

nationalSpirits.description: Ever since the pacification of Araucania and the forceful integration of the land and its people into the Chilean state, the indigenous Mapuche have been displaced, disfavored and dissatisfied. While there are groups among them who strive for cooperation and integration, there are also those who struggle to subvert the state in every way possible.
nationalSpirits.name: The Mapuche Conflict

nationalSpirits.description: The Hacienda - Inquilinaje System of landlords and tenants stems from the old Roman and Imperial Spanish ways of running a country, and are as can be expected, highly outdated and oppressive. The current Chilean haciendas stand out for the poor conditions of workers and being a backward part of the economy, due to practically utilizing serfdom to this day. The only way we can rid ourselves of this problem properly is Land Reform, which should be a main priority if we wish to restore our economy.
nationalSpirits.name: The Hacienda - Inquilinaje System

nationalSpirits.description: Our nation currently suffers from common occurrences of coup attempts and riots, as well as the everyday commonplace protests. Also stemming from the great hostility between politicians, the military and the governmental institutions, nothing functions effectively enough. We must mend these issues if we wish to stabilize the country once and for all.
nationalSpirits.name: Near Anarchic Society

nationalSpirits.description: As it currently stands, the republic is in great peril, and close to the verge of collapse. However, president Arturo Alessandri has since 1925 stabilized much of the situation, and now the reliance on this secret militia is redirecting funding meant to go to the army, thus preventing expansion of the regular forces.
nationalSpirits.name: The Republican Guard

nationalSpirits.description: While there are no formal treaties preventing the expansion of the Brazilian, Chilean or Argentinean navies, there has been an informal arrangement since the Great War that has prevented it. If any of the nations in the region were to begin arming their fleets with new capital ships, a new arms race would be inevitable.
nationalSpirits.name: Legacy of the Naval Arms Race

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: Due to the heavy reliance on the exports of copper and nitrate among other things, the Chilean economy was hit greatly after the great crash, when its largest trading partner, namely the US, stopped importing from Chile, and the country was forced to sell off pieces of land in order for the economy to not collapse completely. Efforts have been made to resolve the situation, but more needs to be done. The Chilean economy will one day be great again!
nationalSpirits.name: The Chilean Economy

nationalSpirits.description: Though there exist no laws to officialize this, most if not all institutions and corporations in  block native Congolese citizens from rising above certain stations, and they are not allowed into higher education.
nationalSpirits.name: The Invisible Roof

nationalSpirits.description: Our state is larger than most, despite our lacking economics and administrative difficulties. The corners of the state are difficult for our central government to reach and control, and communications and logistics between cities can take weeks if not months.
nationalSpirits.name: An Uncontrollably Vast Nation

nationalSpirits.description: The Force Publique is the gendarmerie and military force of the Congo, established in 1877 under the Congo Free State. Its officers are entirely European, be it Belgians or Mercenaries, while the common soldiers are for the most part native to the Congo. The force is very effective at fighting when it counts, however, the inequality and poor management are points of great discontent.
nationalSpirits.name: Force Publique

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: USA considers itself a bastion and maybe even the cradle of democracy and liberty. Whatever they choose to be, their values are difficult to compromise, however tempting some opportunities might seem.
nationalSpirits.name: Home of the Free

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: While a majority of people living in the Sudetenland just want greater autonomy under the existing government, many Sudeten political parties and their supporters could quickly become a fifth column if a German state sought to annex any part of the region.
nationalSpirits.name: The Sudetenland Quandary

nationalSpirits.description: Tomáš Masaryk, often called 'Tatíček Masaryk', meaning 'daddy' or 'father' (of the nation), has been a bedrock of the Czechoslovak nation since its founding. When coalitions were thought impossible to build and political impasses too big to overcome, Masaryk, time after time, was able to pull off political miracles to help strengthen and grow Czechoslovakia. Even in retirement, his sentiments and suggestions to the political leadership are taken more as orders than advice.
nationalSpirits.name: Tatíček Masaryk

nationalSpirits.description: The industrialists wield considerable influence over the country's politics, as they stand at the head of many of Czechoslovakia's largest conglomerates. Their concerns cannot be ignored in matters of economic policy, and economic mobilization is among the measures they would most fiercely resist.
nationalSpirits.name: Industrialist's Veto

nationalSpirits.description: Despite our country's industrial nature, farmers and rural peasants have considerable political sway in many political parties. Their sentiment often influences economic policy decisions, and are a constant political hurdle in making further industrial progress.
nationalSpirits.name: Agrarian Politics

nationalSpirits.description: The Czechoslovakian state has stood alone in Central Europe as a pluralist state that has protected all within her borders. However, the Great Depression has changed that. Economic hardships have caused resentment to build up against the government from various movements within the country. These resentments are now deeply dividing the nation.
nationalSpirits.name: Divided Nation

nationalSpirits.description: The Armada was built from the ashes of Austro-Hungarian Czech Units and the Veterans of the Czechoslovak Legion. The legacy of both still influence how the Armada is run.

effects.label: Supply Combat Penalties on Core Territory

nationalSpirits.name: Československá Armáda

nationalSpirits.description: We have pursued a policy of disarmed neutrality for years, so as not to provoke the Germans. The military is barely more than a token force to symbolically protect our sovereignty. The armed forces have received continual funding cuts over the years - leaving them wholly unprepared for any potential conflicts.
nationalSpirits.name: Neglected Military

nationalSpirits.description: The Great Depression has hit us with full force. As a result, falling demand for agricultural produce have meant debt and foreclosures for many farmers, and skyrocketing unemployment has become a breeding ground for extremist movements on the political fringes.
nationalSpirits.name: Economic Crisis

nationalSpirits.description: Denmark has traditionally been an agrarian society and producer, but its industries have grown in importance and economical significance. We must industrialize and modernize to keep up with the rapid development in the modern age.
nationalSpirits.name: Danish Industrial Capabilities

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: We have signed the London Naval Treaty and accordingly are restricted in the size of our capital ships.
nationalSpirits.name: London Naval Treaty Signatory

nationalSpirits.description: If you can keep your head when all about you Are losing theirs and blaming it on you, If you can meet with Triumph and Disaster And treat those two impostors just the same Yours is the Earth and everything that's in it, And - which is more - you'll be a Man, my son.
nationalSpirits.name: British Stoicism

nationalSpirits.description: With the Great War in recent memory, both the nation's people and leaders are reluctant to send another generation to die in the trenches.
nationalSpirits.name: The War to End All Wars

nationalSpirits.description: Rallying around the King of the United Kingdom and the British Dominions, as well as Emperor of India, the British people stand united and proud of their imperial legacy.
nationalSpirits.name: King George V

nationalSpirits.description: The Ras' of Ethiopia know how to wage war. There is little need to change something that has proven effective for centuries. The enemy is always defeated by an all out attack, where the superior morale and numbers of the Ethiopian army wins the day.
nationalSpirits.name: Conservative High Command

nationalSpirits.description: Emperor Menelik defeated the Italian invaders at the Battle of Adwa. That day we showed the world what our armies are capable of, and forced the colonialist out of our country. We have done it once, and we can do it again.
nationalSpirits.name: The Heroes of Adwa

nationalSpirits.description: The International community has taken a stance in the conflict between Italy and Ethiopia and decided that no other countries should interfere. Ethiopia stands alone in this desperate hour.
nationalSpirits.name: On Our Own

nationalSpirits.description: Sisu is the uniquely Finnish expression for the resilience of the nation's people. Finland has faced harsh odds and will do so again.
nationalSpirits.name: Sisu

nationalSpirits.description: We have signed the London Naval Treaty and accordingly are restricted in the size of our capital ships.
nationalSpirits.name: London Naval Treaty Signatory

nationalSpirits.description: Having emerged victorious from the Great War, the army has developed a dangerously complacent attitude which causes strategic developments to come slowly and with some reluctance.
nationalSpirits.name: Victors of the Great War

nationalSpirits.description: The state of French politics is far from stable. While reforms are needed and welcome, the nation is divided and getting drawn into a conflict would put it at great risk.
nationalSpirits.name: Disjointed Government

nationalSpirits.description: Having fortified the border gives France the opportunity to plan and prepare carefully, but it does sacrifice some flexibility in the event of something unexpected.
nationalSpirits.name: Protected by the Maginot Line

nationalSpirits.description: We are in the enviable position of having very low unemployment, partially because of the massive bloodshed of the Great War. However, this has made it difficult for companies to find skilled workers, and the military finds it hard to compete with the labour market for recruits. Extending the draft would only exacerbate the problem. We should try and find other sources of manpower to make up for the shortfall, either in recruitment or in the economy.
nationalSpirits.name: Full Employment

nationalSpirits.description: Communists and far-right extremist leagues are always ready to resort to violence to advance their political cause.
nationalSpirits.name: Political Violence

nationalSpirits.description: While still a major industrialized country, France has been left behind in terms of concentration of production capabilities. Major reforms are needed to make our economy more competitive in the global scale.
nationalSpirits.name: Inefficient Economy

nationalSpirits.description: Both the local population and the leadership of this province are uneasy about the Low-Key approach towards the Japanese showcased by the Central Government. If nothing is done soon to press the issue and ease the minds of the people, more problems are sure to arise.
nationalSpirits.name: Local Unease

nationalSpirits.description: Due to a lack of morale and overarching control over all of our military forces, looting of local produce is commonplace. We must put an end to this if we wish to create a stable province.
nationalSpirits.name: Commonplace Looting

nationalSpirits.description: Our government is full of corrupt individuals, and it isn't unusual to see money belonging to the state disappear into the pockets of local officials.
nationalSpirits.name: Government Corruption

nationalSpirits.description: The chaos of the civil war has disrupted the creation of an effective state apparatus. The region cannot be properly governed until we have reformed our bureaucracy, by hiring competent people and dividing the governorship in an effective way.
nationalSpirits.name: Ineffective Bureaucracy

nationalSpirits.description: Our state is far from the definition of the word. It's a region and people living their daily lives, under the protection of an independent army who swears loyalty to no state. This leads to very little we can do as a government, but it also has its upsides.
nationalSpirits.name: Warlord State

nationalSpirits.description: Bitterness over defeat in the Great War dominates the politics of this nation.
nationalSpirits.name: Bitter Loser

nationalSpirits.description: Germany has a long and proud military history with a tradition of innovative thinking. The General Staff has sought to improve our armed forces even further since the humiliating defeat in the Great War. Armed with this expertise, our army is poised to strike against any foe who wishes to subjugate our proud people.
nationalSpirits.name: Deutsches Heer

nationalSpirits.description: Through modernization and bold strategy, we challenge the oceans, striking fear into our enemies. Our mighty Battleships will rule over the waves and our U-boats will rule under them.

effects.label: Screening bonus when using only capital ships

nationalSpirits.name: Kriegsmarine

nationalSpirits.description: With unmatched skill and technical prowess, the Luftwaffe is poised to dominate the skies and project our might to any foes foolish enough to challenge us. With cutting-edge aircraft and expertly trained pilots, our air force stands ready to set the skies on fire, destroy any army, and sink every navy that opposes us.
nationalSpirits.name: Luftwaffe

nationalSpirits.description: George II is the unpopular King of the Hellenes, having been restored to the throne from exile in 1935 thanks to a rigged plebiscite. He is determined to keep his throne this time.
nationalSpirits.name: George II

nationalSpirits.description: Greece is heavily indebted to the International Financial Commission, a once influential organization now chaired only by the United Kingdom, France, and Italy. Despite the bloated state of the I.F.C., the countries attached still desire their debts from Greece to be paid in full - meaning that until we've paid our debts, or escaped them some other way, the I.F.C. has us by the purse strings.
nationalSpirits.name: Debt to the I.F.C.

nationalSpirits.description: Our dependence on the heavy industries of foreign powers has left many of our developing sectors firmly in the hands of powerful companies answerable only to foreign governments. We cannot expect to fully ramp up our modernization process until we either strike a deal with these monopolies or we permanently give them the boot from our country.
nationalSpirits.name: Foreign Monopolies

nationalSpirits.description: The brainchild of German economist Hjalmar Schacht, the Schachtplan guarantees Greek access to German markets in exchange for increased imports of raw materials from Greece to Germany. The Germans have been generously keeping us afloat, and yet we may have fallen right into their trap by becoming so dependent on their generosity.
nationalSpirits.name: Schachtplan

nationalSpirits.description: The  Monarchists are .    The  Republicans are .    The  Communists are .    The  Fascists are .    Between 1924 and 1935 we have had twenty three changes of government, thirteen coups, and a dictatorship! The people have had enough and are ready for some stability in their government, but they also remain cautiously skeptical about the odds of any one government surviving very long. We must prove them wrong and bring an end to the constant infighting by bringing our political foes to heel.
nationalSpirits.name: Political Instability

nationalSpirits.description: Greece has traditionally relied on agriculture and light industry with commercial products like tobacco being Greece's primary export. Our reliance on more traditional forms of manufacturing have made us dependent on the heavy industry of larger powers for construction projects. Conflict is brewing, and we need to innovate - fast.
nationalSpirits.name: Agrarian Society

nationalSpirits.description: Due to a lack of morale and overarching control over all of our military forces, looting of local produce is commonplace. We must put an end to this if we wish to create a stable province.
nationalSpirits.name: Commonplace Looting

nationalSpirits.description: Our government is full of corrupt individuals, and it isn't unusual to see money belonging to the state disappear into the pockets of local officials.
nationalSpirits.name: Government Corruption

nationalSpirits.name: Warlord State

nationalSpirits.name: Ma Clique Collective

nationalSpirits.name: Government Corruption

nationalSpirits.description: The chaos of the civil war has disrupted the creation of an effective state apparatus. The region cannot be properly governed until we have reformed our bureaucracy, by hiring competent people and dividing the governorship in an effective way.
nationalSpirits.name: Ineffective Bureaucracy

nationalSpirits.description: Our state is far from the definition of the word. It's a region and people living their daily lives, under the protection of an independent army who swears loyalty to no state. This leads to very little we can do as a government, but it also has its upsides.
nationalSpirits.name: Warlord State

However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.name: Commonplace Looting

nationalSpirits.description: For centuries the family of Orange-Nassau has been interwoven with the very history of the Netherlands itself. Like her forefather William the Silent in the Eighty Years' War, the current Queen, Wilhelmina, will undoubtedly prove an inspiration for Dutchmen rallying to the defense of their homeland, should their country ever be invaded.
nationalSpirits.name: Wilhelmina

nationalSpirits.description: A policy of strict Neutrality has kept the Dutch out of wars with any of its neighbours for nearly 150 years, and, above all, has kept them out of the Great War. The public's belief in their "talisman of protection" is therefore almost fervent, and the weak Dutch government finds itself unable to go against the will of the people and take a strong stand in international politics. Instead, it has resolved to put its faith in the League of Nations, and otherwise adopts an aloof attitude to world events.
nationalSpirits.name: Aloof Neutrality

nationalSpirits.description: As the neutral Netherlands was the closest safe haven for refugees from the Western Front, the Dutch have been but all too close a spectator to the horrors of the Great War. As a result, a strong pacifist movement has grown to permeate large parts of the public, and presents the government with great difficulties in implementing any increase of military expenditure. Only the navy still enjoys a certain measure of prestige in the public eye.  A defensive war or a "war on pacifism" would be needed to truly rid the country of this sentiment.
nationalSpirits.name: Shell-shocked Spectator of the Great War

nationalSpirits.description: Due to the peculiarities of global economics, the Great Depression has hit in the Netherlands much later than elsewhere. The Dutch decision to maintain the Gold Standard, while other nations abandoned it rather quickly, has further exacerbated the "crisis years" in the Netherlands tremendously. In keeping the Guilder from devaluating, no funds are left to aid the ailing Dutch economy, let alone improve the poor state of national defenses.  The crisis can be reduced by investing in public works, and will become largely irrelevant if we capitulate and lose control of the crisis-stricken mainland.
nationalSpirits.name: De Crisisjaren

nationalSpirits.description: The Dutch government in recent years has been marred by weakness. It would not take much to topple it yet again.
nationalSpirits.name: Weak Government

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: The Treaty of Trianon is, in many ways, similar to the Treaty of Versailles, crippling our military and preventing rearmament. Seeing it altered or abolished must be our premier goal. We can do this by seeking a Rapprochement with the Little Entente, proposing the Bled Agreement, or by renouncing it altogether. The last option will be widely considered as very aggressive and may provoke a strong response.
nationalSpirits.name: Treaty of Trianon

nationalSpirits.description: The trade treaty Gyula Gömbös signed with Germany in 1934 is important for stimulating our economy and aiding in recovery from the great depression, but it also has great drawbacks. Though the agreement gives us a favorable price for sales of wheat, the money earned has to remain in an account in Germany and has to be used only to purchase German industrial goods. If this keeps up, Germany will be able to achieve economic domination over our country.
nationalSpirits.name: Gömbös Trade Treaty

nationalSpirits.description: The far-right, largely paramilitary organization M.O.V.E. which was formed in 1919, is at large loyal to its leader and founding figure Gyula Gömbös. Despite this, they also hold large respect for Miklós Horthy, due to his strong anti-communist stance.
nationalSpirits.name: Hungarian National Defense Association

nationalSpirits.description: Our people have formed paramilitary youth organizations known as the Levente. They, under the guise of physical and health training, prepare Hungarian youth both within and without our borders for combat, and the eventual reconquest of our rightful lands.
nationalSpirits.name: Levente Associations

nationalSpirits.description: Christian X is the joint King of Denmark and Iceland. The final link between the two countries.
nationalSpirits.name: Christian X

nationalSpirits.description: Our economy suffered greatly during the Great War when Iceland was isolated from the rest of the world. Then the depression hit, and even though mainland Europe has made a bit of a recovery, the Icelandic economy continues to suffer. But maybe someday, we will astonish the world...
nationalSpirits.name: The Icelandic Economy

nationalSpirits.description: The Dutch East Indies has been a colony of the Netherlands for roughly 350 years, and the administration of the colony is tightly integrated with the Dutch government. The East Indies is often referred to as “the jewel in the Dutch crown”, and the Netherlands has shown no desire to loosen their grip over their precious jewel.
nationalSpirits.name: Netherlands Most Precious Jewel

nationalSpirits.description: The East Indies is a vast archipelago containing hundreds of distinct cultures and languages, making it a notoriously difficult colony to administrate. The various independence movements, cultural barriers, and economic effects of the Great Depression have not helped this issue, and the administration is operating very inefficiently. The “Ethical Policies” which were established in 1918 attempted to improve the situation by mandating ethical labor regulations and giving democratic representations to minority groups, however the great depression has left them mostly unenforced.
nationalSpirits.name: Mismanaged Administration

nationalSpirits.description: The Koninklijk Nederlands Indisch Leger (KNIL) is the long-standing army of the East Indies, operating independently from the Netherlands. The KNIL is made up of both European and Indonesian soldiers, though the cultural and linguistic barriers between the archipelago's many cultures, and the Netherlands, make recruitment a difficult and slow process.
nationalSpirits.name: Royal Netherlands East Indies Army

nationalSpirits.description: While the direct impact that the Great Depression has caused the Indies is small, the subsequent protectionist policies countries have undertaken worldwide have had devastating effects on the Indies' economy, which is reliant on continuous export of raw materials such as rubber and oil.
nationalSpirits.name: The Great Depression

nationalSpirits.description: The Golden Square, a clique of high ranking Iraqi military officers, remains a threat to the stability of the nation. Their sympathies lie with the anti-British regimes of Europe and they have pinned their hopes on them being able to aid in shaking off the yoke of British influence when the opportunity arises.
nationalSpirits.name: The Golden Square

nationalSpirits.description: Although renegotiated in 1930, the Anglo-Iraqi treaty remains a one sided agreement that leaves Iraq a de facto client state of the British Empire. The treaty gives preferential resource rights to Iraq’s oil to the British and allows them to utilize military facilities across the country. This continues to cause massive dissent among the Iraqi people who yearn for real independence. Any government that comes to power will have to decide whether to renegotiate the treaty again, or tear it up and risk the wrath of the British military.
nationalSpirits.name: Anglo-Iraqi Treaty

nationalSpirits.description: Iraq's industry revolves around its agricultural sector, and the conservative leadership in the region has had no interest in developing and industrializing the land. Proper time and effort will need to be dedicated in order to solve the issues in the state.
nationalSpirits.name: Agrarian Society

nationalSpirits.description: The "Soldier King" reminds the Italians of their recent victories in the Great War. His presence and their loyalty to him is a great source of unity for the people.
nationalSpirits.name: Vittorio Emanuele III

nationalSpirits.description: Our allies betrayed Italy and stabbed us in the back when they broke the Pact of London. We sacrificed so much blood at the Isonzo for their victory and they in turn denied us what was ours by right. Now Italy will take her destiny into her own hands and ensure that justice is done.
nationalSpirits.name: Vittoria Mutilata

nationalSpirits.description: We have signed the London Naval Treaty and accordingly are restricted in the size of our capital ships.
nationalSpirits.name: London Naval Treaty Signatory

nationalSpirits.description: Our efforts to save our domestic industries after the Great Depression have proven to be successful. By investing in Italy's industrial capacity even further our productivity will soon rival those of the major powers.
nationalSpirits.name: Ricostruzione Industriale

nationalSpirits.description: Our domestic military complex has fallen behind our rivals in both productivity and technology. We must strengthen Italy's military industries if we want our forces to be successful on the battlefields.
nationalSpirits.name: Military Industry

nationalSpirits.description: The Italian army fought in the first World War and was on the victorious side, but has not been able to keep up with the military modernization. By adapting to modern times we will strengthen the army and be ever-victorious.
nationalSpirits.name: Regio Esercito

nationalSpirits.description: The newest branch of the Italian armed forces and was one of the greatest air forces in the world when it was formed, but has been lagging behind recently. By investing in our air force it can once again become the envy of the world.
nationalSpirits.name: Regia Aeronautica

nationalSpirits.description: Only by securing naval dominance in the Mediterranean can we secure the shores of Italy, but to do this we must invest heavily in modernizing the navy.

effects.label: Attack when in combat alongside the Pride of the Fleet

nationalSpirits.name: Regia Marina

nationalSpirits.description: Militarism dominates the political and social life of the nation, and the belief that the strength of the military is equal to the strength of a nation is prominent. Beginning with the introduction of conscription during the Meiji Restoration, it has now become a core tenet in our national beliefs.
nationalSpirits.name: Militarism

nationalSpirits.description: We have signed the London Naval Treaty and accordingly are restricted in the size of our capital ships.
nationalSpirits.name: London Naval Treaty Signatory

nationalSpirits.description: The various factions within the nation are all vying for power and influence over the [GetImperialInfluenceRulerTitle], a tradition dating back to the oligarchs and military cliques founded during the Meiji and Taisho eras.
nationalSpirits.name: Imperial Influence

nationalSpirits.description: Since the Meiji Restoration we have sought to use the worship at Shinto shrines to promote imperial loyalty and aid in nation building. This has allowed us to build up a country that is ready to sacrifice much in the name of the state.
nationalSpirits.name: State Shintoism

nationalSpirits.description: The IJA is our principal ground force, having played a central role in our rapid modernization during the Meiji era, and having fought in numerous conflicts including the Japan–Qing War, the Russo-Japanese War as well as the Great War. Initially formed from domain armies after the Meiji Restoration, it evolved into a powerful modern military influenced by French and German models.
nationalSpirits.name: Imperial Army

nationalSpirits.description: The IJN was formed in 1868 at the beginning of the Meiji Restoration, and was already by 1920 the third largest navy in the world. Now, our mighty navy is being rapidly expanded, in order for our nation to be able to face the times ahead.
nationalSpirits.name: Imperial Navy

nationalSpirits.description: Our air force is currently divided between the Imperial Japanese Army Air Service and the Imperial Japanese Navy Air Service, being divided both in operation, production as well as research and development between our navy and army. Due to this it faces large logistical bottlenecks, some of which can only be overcome by the merging of our air forces.

effects.label: Air Wing Experience loss when killed
Untrained pilots penalty for new Air Wings

nationalSpirits.name: Army and Naval Air Services

nationalSpirits.description: Our Industrial Revolution only really got started in the 1870s during the Meiji Restoration, after the Iwakura Mission brought home the knowledge needed to get our industrialization projects off the ground. Ever since then, our economy has expanded greatly, and modern industries have been established. Despite this however, our economy is still far behind those in the western world, largely due to our lack of natural resources.
nationalSpirits.name: Early Industrialization Efforts

KBK.name: Federal Republic of Kabardins and Karachay-Balkars

nationalSpirits.description: With the Military Governor in the north and the New 36th Division in the south, the Sinkiang province has been facing further and further escalation. If the states currently in this fight are to turn their gaze towards another conflict, they must first finish their own.
nationalSpirits.name: Battle for Sinkiang

nationalSpirits.description: The population in the province is actively up in arms against our rule, and are resisting heavily. This may prove detrimental to us if we do not deal with it in rapid order.
nationalSpirits.name: Widespread Unrest

nationalSpirits.name: Agrarian Society

nationalSpirits.description: Despite being culturally diverse, our society is dominated by ideas of segregation, spurred on by the colonial authorities. This must be curtailed if stability is to be achieved.
nationalSpirits.name: Ketuanan Melayu

nationalSpirits.description: We are engaged in low-intensity warfare with partisans, defectors and republican terrorists. We should focus on pacifying the countryside in order to hunt these bandits down.
nationalSpirits.name: Banditry

nationalSpirits.description: After the 1905 Japanese seizure of Dalian from Russia, the Kwantung (Kantō in Japanese) garrison placed there became politicized, with expansionist generals taking the initiative in seizing more Chinese land for Japan. This culminated in the Mukden Incident in 1932, when the Empire of Manchukuo was carved out of the petty warlords of the north-east. The Kwantung Army continues to dominate the area and places the interests of their generals above the needs of Manchukuo.  We will only resolve this by getting the Japanese army to recognise us as equals, or by throwing them out by force.
nationalSpirits.name: Kwantung Veto

nationalSpirits.description: Emperor Puyi is the legitimate descendent of the Qing emperors who ruled China for three hundred years. The Xinhai Revolution which deposed him in 1911 was very popular, as the late Qing government was powerless against both the foreigners stealing Chinese land and the regional governors establishing themselves as warlords. Emperor Puyi's installation by Japan as Emperor of Manchukuo is not yet accepted by the Manchurian populace, let alone the rest of China.  We will have to establish the Emperor's independence from Japan to rally the nation under him.
nationalSpirits.name: Low Legitimacy

nationalSpirits.description: In 1934 Puyi was crowned the Emperor of Manchukuo, changing his title from Chief Executive to Emperor, and as such as new Era name was adopted. Ruling previously under the name Datong, he now rules Manchuria as Emperor Kangde.
nationalSpirits.name: The Kangde Emperor

nationalSpirits.description: The supporters of Calles are enriching themselves and abusing their power. Appointed for loyalty rather than ability, they perpetuate a patronage system which corrupts every office and rank in the country. Unless they are reigned in, ordinary Mexicans will continue to deride our ruling government as 'robolucionarios', robber-revolutionaries.
nationalSpirits.name: Callistas

nationalSpirits.description: The Constitution of 1917 requires measures aimed against the influence of the Catholic Church in Mexico. The Cristeros rebelled in the 1920s because of attempts to enforce those laws, but the people may now be ready for a secular state.
nationalSpirits.name: Weak Church

nationalSpirits.description: In order to exploit oil in Mexico, foreign companies have signed concession contracts ensuring that they can freely extract oil on defined territories for a prolonged period of time in exchange for payments. However the sum paid by the companies was far below the value of the oil extracted and enabled them to get a profit margin much higher than in countries such as the US, while putting the oil reserves of Mexico indirectly under foreign control.
nationalSpirits.name: Oil Concessions

nationalSpirits.description: The rulers of Mexico have been drawn from revolutionary army officers for almost three decades. The turbulent times we went through demanded firm leadership. The question is: has the turbulence passed, or is it becoming more severe? Should we professionalize the army or allow regional strongmen - caciques and caudillos - to carve out petty fiefdoms? Generals like Saturnino Cedillo in San Luis Potosí are raising private militias to protect their power. The many rebellions launched by dissatisfied officers in the past are likely to continue unless we act.
nationalSpirits.name: Politicized Army

nationalSpirits.description: General Saturnino Cedillo and the caudillos aligned to him are jealously guarding their influence. We may have to act against them if they stand in the way of the government.
nationalSpirits.name: Caudillo Tensions Moderate

However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: The fact that Johan Nygaardsvold managed to get a stable government is no small feat, him and his cabinet seem to think that was the last hurdle, but what they don't know yet is that it is only the first one of many.
nationalSpirits.name: Complacent Cabinet

nationalSpirits.description: Norway has not taken care of their armed forces for a very long time, and now they would be more useful in a museum than in battle.
nationalSpirits.name: Obsolete Armed Forces

nationalSpirits.description: The Great Depression of 1929 is still felt in every household and business across Norway. It may need a miracle to make it past this decade.
nationalSpirits.name: The Hard Thirties

nationalSpirits.description: SOU and communists abroad have instilled fear in many Norwegians, to the point that fascism is comparatively not a real concern as long as they deal with the red menace.
nationalSpirits.name: Anti-Communist Sentiment

nationalSpirits.description: In some cases, calling them fortifications would be generous. They're not only mothballed, but they are not ready for modern combat at all.
nationalSpirits.name: Crumbling Fortifications

nationalSpirits.description: The Government Railways Board was created in 1931 as a restructuring of the Railways Department in an attempt to separate decision making away from government departments. However, there has been little sign of improvement to the rail network since it was established. There is mounting pressure for the government to abolish the board and to take back direct control.
nationalSpirits.name: The Government Railways Board

nationalSpirits.description: The collapse of the global economy in 1929 hit New Zealand's largely agricultural economy very hard. With countries purchasing less produce from New Zealand, many found themselves unemployed, reducing consumer purchasing power and in turn causing other industries to collapse. Years of austerity has left the nation yearning for a change in direction.
nationalSpirits.name: The Great Depression

nationalSpirits.description: New Zealand remains a committed member of the British Commonwealth and retains the King as the rightful head of state. The economy of New Zealand is also highly integrated into the wider imperial economic system.
nationalSpirits.name: British Commonwealth Loyalty

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: The Chaco War has just ended, having lasted from 1932 to 1935. The will to fight has been completely drained from even the most ardent supporters of expansionism in both Bolivia and Paraguay, and many lay dead in the still disputed region of Chaco Boreal.
nationalSpirits.name: The Toll of the Chaco War
The Aftershock of the Triple Alliance

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: Formally known as the Anglo-Persian Oil Company, the AIOC was founded by Britain in 1909 following the discovery of a significantly sized oil field in Masjed Soleiman. Many in Iran feel this company is taking advantage of our nation's resources and workforce, and have not fulfilled the many promises they agreed upon.
nationalSpirits.name: Anglo-Iranian Oil Company

nationalSpirits.description: Feudalism is an outdated system of structuring society around the holding of land in exchange for service and labor. Despite being a medieval concept, it is still in play within many of the rural regions of Iran.
nationalSpirits.name: Rural Feudalism

nationalSpirits.description: Traditionally, Iran has been following Islam for generations. It is considered the state religion and that which the majority of the population follows. There are those in government who seek to secularize religion and state, however doing so will be a monumental task and come with much pushback.
nationalSpirits.name: Islamic Traditions

nationalSpirits.description: Iran encompasses some territory that once used to belong to the Azerbaijani people. As such, there is a significant diaspora of people who are unhappy with our rule. In the years prior, our government was able to crush a number of rebellions from this region of Iran, but the rebellious sentiment remains.
nationalSpirits.name: Azerbaijani Resistance

nationalSpirits.description: Iran encompasses some territory that once used to belong to the Kurdish people. As such, there is a significant diaspora of people who are unhappy with our rule. In the years prior, our government was able to crush a number of rebellions from this region of Iran, but the rebellious sentiment remains.
nationalSpirits.name: Kurdish Resistance

nationalSpirits.description: The Philippines are a nation of islands, and as such our people have developed a natural affinity to the sea.
nationalSpirits.name: Island Nation

nationalSpirits.description: The Great Depression has hit the United States hard, and being a subject of theirs we were not spared from its financial destruction.
nationalSpirits.name: The Great Depression

nationalSpirits.description: The land-borne forces of the Philippines, primarily responsible for defending our home-islands. Initially formed of a number of scout units, the forces under their control continues to grow.
nationalSpirits.name: Philippine Army

nationalSpirits.description: A foreign power holds significant sway over our nation, and if we ever wish to truly feel our independence then this overbearing control they maintain over us must be broken.
nationalSpirits.name: American Interference

nationalSpirits.description: A foreign nation has almost complete control over our exports and imports, essentially rendering our economy in a state of embargo; incapable of trading freely with the rest of the world.

effects.label: Expected number of factories put on Consumer Goods

nationalSpirits.name: Embargoed Economy

nationalSpirits.description: This piece of legislation was passed by the Sejm in 1935 to ensure the continued peace and stability of the Polish state. The constitution grants almost total powers to the President, granting him supremacy over the Sejm and Senate.
nationalSpirits.name: The April Constitution

nationalSpirits.description: Angered by a total lack of action to counter the gross impoverished conditions of Eastern Poland, a Peasants’ Strike is on the horizon for Poland. If not addressed before the year is out, Poland risks unknown levels of civil unrest across the nation.
nationalSpirits.name: Looming Peasants' Strike

nationalSpirits.description: Currently, the Sanation Left is a very marginal threat to the Dictatorship and is in no position to threaten the stability of the regime.
nationalSpirits.name: Low Sanation Left Opposition

nationalSpirits.description: Currently, the Sanation Right are satisfied with the government and are of very little threat to the regime.
nationalSpirits.name: Low Sanation Right Opposition

nationalSpirits.description: With the constant coups and counter-coups since the implementation of the Republic in 1910, Army officers are more preoccupied with politics than with keeping discipline and promoting training in the army. The rank and file is demoralized, poorly equipped and poorly trained.
nationalSpirits.name: Unreliable Army

nationalSpirits.description: The era of the Republic installed in 1910 was described as one of "continual anarchy, government corruption, rioting and pillage, assassinations, arbitrary imprisonment and religious persecution". It witnessed the inauguration of nine presidents, 44 cabinet re-organisations and 21 revolutions. Even after the Military coup of 1926, there have been several failed revolutionary attempts.
nationalSpirits.name: Unstable Republic

nationalSpirits.description: Carrying our old minting presses during the Long March was never an option, and as a result our state bank now struggles to get to their bearings in this new and difficult situation.
nationalSpirits.name: Defunct State Bank

nationalSpirits.description: The long retreat into Shanxi has depleted our forces, and the Yan'an Base Area is not yet ready to support a major uprising. It will take time or outside help to recover.
nationalSpirits.name: Aftermath of the Long March

nationalSpirits.description: Exhausted from the Long March, our Red Army is not fit for combat just yet. We must form new units and form a new Army of Liberation.
nationalSpirits.name: Red Army Weakened

nationalSpirits.description: The peasants have suffered hard in the civil war. If we want to become accepted as the legitimate government of China, we must win their support.
nationalSpirits.name: Low Popular Support

nationalSpirits.description: The party is internally divided about the best way to proceed. Struggles between various factions have erupted and will continue until one of them reigns supreme.
nationalSpirits.name: Power Struggles

nationalSpirits.description: The Central Committee of the Chinese Communist Party is the highest political organ of the Party. Established in the 1920s, the Central Committee is led by the General Secretary. The Politburo is the executive committee and is made up of the senior leadership of the Party. Zhang Wentian took over the General Secretariat from Bo Gu in January 1935.
nationalSpirits.name: The Central Committee

nationalSpirits.name: PRC_the_chinese_red_army

nationalSpirits.description: Consisting of mainly rural settlements with little industrial development and little to no education for its people,  stands before a challenge on many planes.
nationalSpirits.name: Agrarian Society

nationalSpirits.description: The United States has long promised to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers, meaning any incursion into our territory would likely mean the USA would come to our aid. However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: The Indian system of food production is very fragile. Even a small interruption might cause a collapse.
nationalSpirits.name: Risk of Famine

nationalSpirits.description: The local administrators believe that their agrarian lifestyle has made a large part of the Indian population simply unfit for military service or warfare of any kind. They maintain that we should only recruit from the so-called "martial tribes". This belief is so wide-spread and well-entrenched that it will require at least a generation, or significant rural investment to overcome.
nationalSpirits.name: Agrarian Society

RNG.name: Reformed Government of the Republic of China

nationalSpirits.description: We still labor under the effects of the Unequal Treaties that formalize the "Open Door Policy" towards China. The foreigners still have extraterritorial rights, and we are not in full control of our economy.
nationalSpirits.name: Nine Power Treaty

nationalSpirits.description: Our armed forces are rife with corruption and nepotism. If we want to turn them into a potent fighting force, we will have to engage in a lengthy and expensive program of army reform.
nationalSpirits.name: Army Corruption

nationalSpirits.description: The chaos of the civil war has disrupted the creation of an effective state apparatus. More than a third of available recruits are not drafted, simply because no one knows they exist. Reforming the examination process will ensure that we hire competent people.
nationalSpirits.name: Ineffective Bureaucracy

nationalSpirits.description: Our officers are not yet up to the task of managing a modern war. Hard lessons will have to be learned before they are truly equal to their counterparts in other nations. Educating them will be part of a bigger program of army reform.
nationalSpirits.name: Incompetent Officers

nationalSpirits.description: Our economists have noticed a slight increase in inflation. We should keep an eye on that.
nationalSpirits.name: Low Inflation

nationalSpirits.description: King Carol II is well known for his expensive tastes and his willingness to indulge the even more lavish tastes of his mistress. He has caused considerable scandals in the past, and will likely continue to do so unless he is replaced or shown the error of his ways.
nationalSpirits.name: King Carol II's Lifestyle

nationalSpirits.description: Neutrality is sometimes viewed as a craven stance, but this nation trusts that when the dust settles, those who didn't take sides may be better off than those who did.
nationalSpirits.name: Neutral Foreign Policy

nationalSpirits.description: No one in the international community will come to [ROOT.getname] aid in a time of war.
nationalSpirits.name: Back Against the Mountains

nationalSpirits.description: The Ox-wagon Sentinel is an Afrikaner nationalist organization vocally supportive of Nazi ideas. They carry out a campaign of sabotage against state infrastructure, and will continue to do so unless we side with the Nazis ourselves.
nationalSpirits.name: Ossewabrandwag

nationalSpirits.description: Factions within the Yugoslavian Air Force are opposed to cooperating with Germany. They may attempt to overthrow the regime if the country opens their borders to or enters an alliance with the Third Reich.
nationalSpirits.name: Anti-German Military

nationalSpirits.description: Due to a lack of morale and overarching control over all of our military forces, looting of local produce is commonplace. We must put an end to this if we wish to create a stable province.
nationalSpirits.name: Commonplace Looting

nationalSpirits.description: Our government is full of corrupt individuals, and it isn't unusual to see money belonging to the state disappear into the pockets of local officials.
nationalSpirits.name: Government Corruption

nationalSpirits.description: The chaos of the civil war has disrupted the creation of an effective state apparatus. The region cannot be properly governed until we have reformed our bureaucracy, by hiring competent people and dividing the governorship in an effective way.
nationalSpirits.name: Ineffective Bureaucracy

nationalSpirits.description: Our state is far from the definition of the word. It's a region and people living their daily lives, under the protection of an independent army who swears loyalty to no state. This leads to very little we can do as a government, but it also has its upsides.
nationalSpirits.name: Warlord State

nationalSpirits.description: While nominally being united under the banner of the "Sichuan Clique", there are several different rulers in our province that have their own goals and ambitions. Some, like Liu Wenhui have even created their own little realm that's functionally separate from the rest of the province, while others have their own ideas about how the army should be handled.
nationalSpirits.name: A Loose Unity

nationalSpirits.name: Battle for Sinkiang

nationalSpirits.description: Comrades, with the defeat of the vile Trotskyite counter revolutionaries we were able to focus on defending the revolution. Our goal, our hope, our slogan is Socialism in One Country. We will build a bountiful socialist utopia here in the Soviet Union and the rest of the world will inevitably embrace it.
nationalSpirits.name: Home of the Revolution

nationalSpirits.description: Paranoia and pathological distrust stemming from old power struggles impact the leadership of this nation.
nationalSpirits.name: Trotskyite Plot?

nationalSpirits.description: Military commissars often hold fervent ideological speeches and political discussions among the ranks, but in many cases they also engage in excessive administration, overzealous scrutiny of military officers, and even obstruction of the orders of unit commanders.
nationalSpirits.name: Politicized Military

effects.label: Air Wing Experience loss when killed

nationalSpirits.description: In 1830 King Ferdinand VII promulgated the Pragmatic Sanction and made his daughter, the future Isabella II, heir presumptive. This act removed his brother Infante Carlos from the line of succession, and so, upon the King's death, supporters of Infante Carlos ignited a series of civil wars, uniting under the banner of Carlism and fighting for the reinstatement of the Salic line of succession.  A century later, the Carlist movement is still very much alive, and its militias, called Requetés, train unceasingly in preparation for the time where they will once more be needed to defend Christianity and champion the return of the rightful King.
nationalSpirits.name: Carlism

nationalSpirits.description: The failed "Sanjurjada" military coup attempt in 1932 still casts it shadow over the Spanish military to this day. In the aftermath, various disloyal military commanders, among them the coup's leader José Sanjurjo, fled to exile in Portugal and continue their plotting even now.  Even this failure has not discouraged disloyal officers, however, as even within Spain itself many desire to see a return to a Monarchy, or even a strong Fascist dictatorship. Too strong meddling by the government in the internal affairs of the military may well spark yet another uprising; far more violent and bloody than the last.
nationalSpirits.name: Military Disloyalty

nationalSpirits.description: The Spanish political scene is one of increasing polarization and violence. Only two years have elapsed since the last big uprising, the Asturias Miners' Strike, and the current political climate appears to have all the makings of a new, far larger and far less localized uprising. It seems unlikely that the upcoming elections will put an end to this downward spiral of societal unrest.
nationalSpirits.name: Political Violence

nationalSpirits.description: The country finds itself seemingly in the grips of the starting stages of a workers' revolution; strike upon strike paralyze the industry and daily life as workers demand less work and more pay, and poor tenant farmers increasingly appropriate farmland while the government turns a blind eye.
nationalSpirits.name: National Strikes

SRL.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

nationalSpirits.description: Our military suffers from a severe lack of ammunition for our weapons, as well as a jumble of different small arms manufactured and bought from different foreign countries. We should address these issues as soon as possible.
nationalSpirits.name: Severe lack of ammunition

nationalSpirits.description: When Gustaf V took the throne, he still had great authority over Swedish politics. Over the years, his authority has been eroded by the establishment of a parliamentary democracy. While nominally in support of the arrangement, friction between the Riksdag and the King occur regularly.
nationalSpirits.name: King Gustaf V

nationalSpirits.description: Neutrality is sometimes viewed as a craven stance, but this nation trusts that when the dust settles, those who didn't take sides may be better off than those who did.
nationalSpirits.name: Neutral Foreign Policy

nationalSpirits.description: Per Albin Hansson and the Social Democrats have introduced a wave of reforms over the years that have come to be known as ‘Folkhemmet’ or ‘the people’s home.’ The reforms have created a social safety net, better housing and greater access to education for the masses at the expense of the military budget. While many hold these reforms dearly, those of a more affluent or militaristic standing look upon them with disdain.
nationalSpirits.name: Folkhemmet

effects.label: Justify war goal time on us

nationalSpirits.description: Unlike most other nations, in Switzerland, every person that meets the criteria for recruitment is expected to take up arms in their local Militias when called upon. This allows us to have a large percentage of the population in reserve without major consequences to our economy as long as they're not deployed.
nationalSpirits.name: Swiss Citizen Militias

nationalSpirits.description: While there isn't a large Fascist movement native to Switzerland, our Fascist neighbors are keen on tearing up our confederation from the inside, with fifth column and propaganda operations in every canton, but specially in the German and Italian speaking ones.
nationalSpirits.name: Foreign Fascist Propaganda

nationalSpirits.description: When unifying the Tibetan heartland under the control of the Gelug school, after defeating the rival Tsangpa prince in a prolonged civil war, the 5th Dalai Lama established a government after which our current is also modeled. Though isolationist, it leads to a more stable state.
nationalSpirits.name: Ganden Podrang

nationalSpirits.description: Though under-equipped and massively outdated, our army has helped us suppress the Bai Lang Rebellion and keep nominal control over the realm. We must continue expanding it to keep the state safe from rival warlord intrusions.
nationalSpirits.name: Dmag Dpung Bod

nationalSpirits.description: The Turkish officer corps are some of the staunchest protectors of Kemalist values. Kemalism remains challenged as an ideology, but the officer corps stand ready to assist the government in all manners concerning the protection of the state.
nationalSpirits.name: Kemalist Officers

nationalSpirits.description: Turkey's internal divisions are represented geographically through State Modifiers: the  Kemalists can be found in the west and in the north, the religious  Traditionalists can be found in the central hinterlands as well as in the south, while the  Kurdish people can be found in the south-east of the nation.   Interactions with the different Factions can be accessed through the Decisions Tab, as well as through some Focus Effects and Event Options.   Turkey is beset by internal divisions that are drawn across ideological, religious, and ethnic lines. The Kemalists hope to turn Turkey into a secularized state, but there is a large percentage of the population who are fundamentally opposed to the very concept of secularism. In the east, the Kurdish people have caused a great deal of trouble for the Turkish government and seem determined to go the way of rebellion over assimilation. To mend the internal divisions of our country, we will either need to approach these issues with a gentle hand or an iron fist.
nationalSpirits.name: Sectarian Woes

nationalSpirits.description: The Turkish Armed Forces is young much like the country of Turkey itself. Even though our armies emerged from the War of Liberation victorious against the Entente and the Ottomans, our nation paid the price for freedom in blood. There has been little to no enthusiasm for war after losing nearly a quarter of our population in the Great War, but with the spectre of war looming over the world once again it seems that we will have no choice but to either modernize our forces fast, or ensure that the war never reaches our borders.
nationalSpirits.name: Disorganized Armed Forces

nationalSpirits.description: Though the literacy within our nation has increased drastically since the initial implementations of the alphabet and language reforms thanks to Atatürk's literacy drive and national education campaigns, even going as far as earning himself the title başöğretmen, there is still much to be done.
nationalSpirits.name: Widespread Illiteracy

nationalSpirits.description: Modeled after the Russian Five-Year Plans, and guided by both Russian and American experts, our first five year plan came into effect on April 17, 1934. Through this plan, we aim to have 20 new factories built by the time the second plan is implemented.
nationalSpirits.name: Birinci Beş Yıllık Sanayi Planı

However, if our politics no longer align with that of the United States, we may find ourselves unprotected.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine

nationalSpirits.description: The Bureau of Ordnance influences any ship designs made.  This spirit is available due to our amazing torpedoes.
nationalSpirits.name: Bureau of Ordnance

nationalSpirits.description: We have signed the London Naval Treaty and accordingly are restricted in the size of our capital ships.
nationalSpirits.name: London Naval Treaty Signatory

nationalSpirits.description: Since the mid 19th century, we have endeavored to protect the western hemisphere from outside interference by colonial powers. Although the parameters of this doctrine have evolved over time, the crux of it means that our neighbors in North and South America will expect us to aid them in times of conflict. It is of course up to our own government to determine when and how to enforce the doctrine.
nationalSpirits.name: Monroe Doctrine Enforcer

nationalSpirits.description: Although a worldwide phenomenon, the Great Depression started with a stock market crash in the United States and has caused unemployment rates to soar and tax revenue to plummet. The American people and its government have enough to worry about without getting involved in another war.
nationalSpirits.name: The Great Depression

nationalSpirits.description: USA considers itself a bastion and maybe even the cradle of democracy and liberty. Whatever they choose to be, their values are difficult to compromise, however tempting some opportunities might seem.
nationalSpirits.name: Home of the Free

nationalSpirits.name: Ma Clique Collective

nationalSpirits.description: The political representatives of Croatia have been pushing for a federal organization of the Kingdom. Unless their demands are met, they will continue to oppose every move by the central government. They might even launch an uprising if they believe the time is right.
nationalSpirits.name: Croatian Opposition

nationalSpirits.description: The Macedonians have not quite accepted their identity as Serbs and keep demanding special rights. Political support from Bulgaria no doubt plays a role.
nationalSpirits.name: Macedonian Opposition

nationalSpirits.description: Slovenes have long since wanted their own state. Although they have accepted our rule, they are not particularly enthusiastic about it. Slovene industrialists rarely invest in local businesses and seem to prefer to spend their money abroad.
nationalSpirits.name: Slovene Nationalism
